description: Delete a quick reply (canned response) by ID. Run get_quick_replies first to find the ID. To only hide it, use update_quick_reply with status=false instead.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to delete the quick reply.

id.description: ID of the quick reply to delete

name: delete_quick_reply
